MERGE INTO A1MFG.SYS_FILE_MANAGE T USING( SELECT #{routeName} AS ROUTE_NAME,#{functionId} AS FUNCTION_ID, #{filePath} AS FILE_PATH ,#{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS FILE_NAME,#{functionType} AS FUNCTION_TYPE ,#{remark} AS REMARK,#{createUser} AS CREATE_USER,SYSDATE AS CREATE_TIME, SYSDATE AS UPDATE_TIME,#{updateUser} AS UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.FUNCTION_ID = S.FUNCTION_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE,T.UPDATE_USER = S.UPDATE_USER
,T.FILE_NAME = S.FILE_NAME
,T.REMARK = S.REMARK
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ROUTE_NAME,FUNCTION_ID,FILE_NAME,FUNCTION_TYPE,FILE_PATH,REMARK,CREATE_TIME,CREATE_USER) VALUES(S.ROUTE_NAME,S.FUNCTION_ID,S.FILE_NAME,S.FUNCTION_TYPE,S.FILE_PATH,S.REMARK,S.CREATE_TIME,S.CREATE_USER)

SELECT MAX(MENU_ID)MENU_ID,FUNCTION_ID,MAX(REMARK)REMARK ,MAX(TIPS)TIPS,MAX(TABLE_NAME)TABLE_NAME,MAX(ETL_NAME)ETL_NAME ,MAX(UPDATE_TIME)UPDATE_TIME,MAX(UPDATE_USER)UPDATE_USER,MAX(DEVELOPER)DEVELOPER ,LISTAGG(OWNER,'/')WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY UPDATE_USER)OWNER FROM( SELECT MENU_ID,C.FUNCTION_ID,C.REMARK,C.TIPS,C.TABLE_NAME,C.ETL_NAME,C.UPDATE_TIME,C.UPDATE_USER,C.DEVELOPER ,D.CNAME ||'('||D.EMAIL||')' OWNER FROM( SELECT A.MENU_ID,A.FUNCTION_ID,A.OWNER ,A.REMARK,A.TIPS,A.TABLE_NAME,A.ETL_NAME,A.UPDATE_TIME,A.UPDATE_USER ,B.CNAME ||'('||B.EXT||')' DEVELOPER FROM( SELECT MENU_ID,FUNCTION_ID,OWNER,DEVELOPER,REMARK,TIPS,TABLE_NAME,ETL_NAME,UPDATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER FROM A1MFG.SYS_FUNCTION_LIST WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} )A LEFT JOIN WORKFLOW.HR_USERS B ON A.DEVELOPER = B.EMAIL )C LEFT JOIN WORKFLOW.HR_USERS D ON 1=1 WHERE '/'||C.OWNER||'/' LIKE '%/'||D.EMAIL||'/%' AND D.EMAIL IS NOT NULL )GROUP BY FUNCTION_ID

SELECT FUNCTION_ID,MENU_ID,MAX(REMARK) REMARK, MAX(TIPS)TIPS,MAX(TABLE_NAME)TABLE_NAME,MAX(ETL_NAME)ETL_NAME,MAX(DEVELOPER)DEVELOPER ,LISTAGG(OWNER,' / ')WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY 1)OWNER FROM( SELECT DISTINCT A.MENU_ID,A.FUNCTION_ID,A.REMARK,A.TIPS,A.TABLE_NAME,A.ETL_NAME ,CASE WHEN A.OWNER = 'A12_MFG' THEN 'A12_MFG' ELSE B.CNAME||'('||B.EMAIL||')' END OWNER ,CASE WHEN A.DEVELOPER = '' THEN 'Reporting' ELSE C.CNAME||'('||C.EXT||')' END DEVELOPER FROM( SELECT MENU_ID,FUNCTION_ID,DEVELOPER,REMARK,TIPS,TABLE_NAME,ETL_NAME ,TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(t.OWNER, '[^/]+', 1, levels.column_value)) AS OWNER FROM( SELECT MENU_ID,FUNCTION_ID,OWNER,DEVELOPER,REMARK,TIPS,TABLE_NAME,ETL_NAME,UPDATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER FROM A1MFG.SYS_FUNCTION_LIST WHERE FUNCTION_ID = #{functionId} )T, TABLE(CAST(MULTISET( SELECT LEVEL FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(t.OWNER, '/') + 1 ) AS sys.odcinumberlist)) levels )A LEFT JOIN WORKFLOW.HR_USERS B ON A.OWNER = B.EMAIL LEFT JOIN WORKFLOW.HR_USERS C ON A.DEVELOPER = C.EMAIL WHERE (B.BYWORK = '0' AND C.BYWORK = '0') OR A.OWNER ='A12_MFG' )GROUP BY FUNCTION_ID,MENU_ID

SELECT MAX(MENU_ID)MENU_ID,FUNCTION_ID,MAX(REMARK)REMARK ,MAX(DEVELOPER)DEVELOPER ,LISTAGG(OWNER,'/')WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY 1)OWNER ,MAX(MENU_NAME)MENU_NAME FROM( SELECT E.MENU_ID,E.FUNCTION_ID,E.REMARK,E.MENU_NAME,E.DEVELOPER ,CASE WHEN E.OWNER = 'A12_MFG' THEN 'A12_MFG' ELSE F.CNAME ||'('||F.EMAIL||')' END OWNER FROM( SELECT C.MENU_ID,C.FUNCTION_ID,C.OWNER,C.REMARK,C.MENU_NAME ,CASE WHEN D.CNAME IS NULL THEN 'Reporting' ELSE D.CNAME ||'('||D.EXT||')' END DEVELOPER FROM( SELECT MENU_ID,FUNCTION_ID,OWNER,DEVELOPER,REMARK,MENU_NAME FROM( SELECT A.MENU_ID,A.FUNCTION_ID,A.OWNER,A.DEVELOPER,A.REMARK ,B.MENU_NAME FROM A1MFG.SYS_FUNCTION_LIST A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.SYS_MENU_LIST B ON A.MENU_ID = B.ROUTE_NAME )WHERE OWNER <> 'A12_MFG'
AND MENU_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{menuName},'%'))
AND MENU_ID = #{menuId}
AND FUNCTION_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{functionId},'%'))
AND OWNER LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{owner},'%'))
AND DEVELOPER LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{developer},'%'))
AND TABLE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{tableName},'%'))
AND ETL_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{etlName},'%'))
)C LEFT JOIN WORKFLOW.HR_USERS D ON C.DEVELOPER = D.EMAIL )E LEFT JOIN WORKFLOW.HR_USERS F ON 1=1 WHERE ('/'||E.OWNER||'/' LIKE '%/'||F.EMAIL||'/%' AND F.EMAIL IS NOT NULL) )GROUP BY FUNCTION_ID UNION ALL SELECT MENU_ID,FUNCTION_ID,REMARK,DEVELOPER,OWNER,MENU_NAME FROM( SELECT A.MENU_ID,A.FUNCTION_ID,A.REMARK ,CASE WHEN C.CNAME IS NULL THEN 'Reporting' ELSE C.CNAME ||'('||C.EXT||')' END DEVELOPER ,A.OWNER,B.MENU_NAME FROM A1MFG.SYS_FUNCTION_LIST A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.SYS_MENU_LIST B ON A.MENU_ID = B.ROUTE_NAME LEFT JOIN WORKFLOW.HR_USERS C ON A.DEVELOPER = C.EMAIL WHERE A.OWNER = 'A12_MFG'
AND B.MENU_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{menuName},'%'))
AND A.MENU_ID = #{menuId}
AND A.FUNCTION_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{functionId},'%'))
AND A.OWNER LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{owner},'%'))
AND A.DEVELOPER LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{developer},'%'))
AND A.TABLE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{tableName},'%'))
AND A.ETL_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{etlName},'%'))
)

MERGE INTO A1MFG.SYS_FUNCTION_LIST T USING ( SELECT #{menuId} MENU_ID,#{functionId} FUNCTION_ID,#{owner,jdbcType=VARCHAR}OWNER, #{developer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}DEVELOPER,#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}REMARK ,#{tips ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}TIPS,#{tableName ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}TABLE_NAME ,#{etlName ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}ETL_NAME,SYSDATE UPDATE_TIME,#{updateUser}UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL )S ON (T.FUNCTION_ID = S.FUNCTION_ID AND T.MENU_ID = S.MENU_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.UPDATE_TIME = S.UPDATE_TIME,T.UPDATE_USER = S.UPDATE_USER, T.OWNER = S.OWNER ,T.DEVELOPER = S.DEVELOPER,T.REMARK = S.REMARK ,T.TIPS = S.TIPS,T.TABLE_NAME = S.TABLE_NAME,T.ETL_NAME = S.ETL_NAME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MENU_ID,FUNCTION_ID,OWNER,DEVELOPER,REMARK,TIPS,TABLE_NAME,ETL_NAME,UPDATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER) VALUES(S.MENU_ID,S.FUNCTION_ID,S.OWNER,S.DEVELOPER,S.REMARK,S.TIPS,S.TABLE_NAME,S.ETL_NAME,S.UPDATE_TIME,S.UPDATE_USER)
